body:
"Enhancers" was a proposal at the connector level. This PR changes the architecture of how the logic is shared among all the Refinements/Menu components.

We had a discussion with AlexS two years ago about how difficult it was to maintain the RefinementList component because of the way it was designed. This is another take that makes it easier to add features for React InstantSearch parity:

- Search For Facet Values
- Show More

Again, this is only at the component level.

It also makes the components easier to test. They are now their own components, reusing the `SharedRefinementList`. I removed some dead code about a inexistent `depth` CSS class. Finally, they use TypeScript.

I plan to write tests for the `List` component, because nothing was tested so far.
